sku.short: UltraTech Portland Pozzolana Cement, 50 kg bag. Fly-ash blended cement to IS 1489 (Part 1) for RCC, masonry and plaster work.
sku.long:
## What it is

UltraTech Portland Pozzolana Cement is a fly-ash blended grey cement supplied in a 50 kg HDPE/PP laminated woven bag. It is made by the dry process: high-quality clinker of balanced chemical composition is inter-ground with fly ash containing high reactive silica and high-purity gypsum, or high-quality Ordinary Portland Cement is blended with finer fly ash. The blend conforms to IS 1489 (Part 1), the Indian Standard for fly-ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement, and as a blended cement it carries no numeric strength grade.

## What it's for

This is a general-purpose cement for construction in all applications, including RCC, PCC, masonry and plastering. Because the pozzolanic reaction cuts permeability, UltraTech also positions it for marine structures, hydraulic constructions, dams, underground basements and sewerage systems, where resistance to chemical attack and protection against corrosion of steel matter most. In ordinary house building it suits foundation, column, beam and slab concrete around M15 to M30, at a typical water–cement ratio near 0.45.

## Key specifications

Mill testing against IS 1489 (Part 1) returned 28.6 MPa compressive strength at 3 days and 58 MPa at 28 days, with an initial setting time of 150 minutes and a final set at 225 minutes — a long working window that suits hand placement in warm weather. Chloride content is held at 0.035% and insoluble residue at 22.80% by mass. Fineness is around 340 m²/kg Blaine, specific gravity about 2.9, standard consistency about 30%, and Le Chatelier soundness expansion about 1 mm. The composition runs roughly 66% clinker, 30% fly ash and 4% gypsum.

## Application and installation notes

Mix the dry constituents until uniform, then add water gradually to the design ratio; place and compact within about 30 minutes. Blended cements gain strength more slowly than OPC, so cure with water for a full 14 days. Work between 5 °C and 40 °C ambient. Store bags off the floor on wooden planks, clear of external walls, in a dry covered godown, stacked no more than 10 high, and use within 3 months of packing.

## What's in the box

One 50 kg sealed bag, approximately 450 × 700 × 140 mm.

sku.short: ACC Suraksha Power Cement, 50 kg PP bag. Fly-ash PPC with optimised particle size for workable, dense concrete, masonry and plaster.
sku.long:
## What it is

ACC Suraksha Power is a fly-ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement supplied in a 50 kg PP woven bag. It is made by the dry process, with clinker inter-ground with specially processed reactive silica and gypsum, and each batch comprehensively tested. Grinding is controlled for uniform particle size and distribution, producing spherical particles that improve workability. As a blended cement to IS 1489 (Part 1), it carries no numeric strength grade.

## What it's for

ACC positions this as the everyday bag for house building: concrete for foundations, beams and columns, brick masonry, wall plastering and slab casting. The dense concrete it produces resists water and chemical penetration, which is what protects embedded steel from corrosion. It suits general residential concrete around M15 to M30 at a water–cement ratio near 0.45, and it is equally at home in the finishing trades — plaster and block work — where the spherical particle shape reduces the water needed for a given workability.

## Key specifications

The blend runs approximately 64% clinker, 32% fly ash and 4% gypsum. Expect about 24 MPa compressive strength at 3 days, 35 MPa at 7 days and 48 MPa at 28 days, with initial set at about 130 minutes and final set at about 210 minutes. Fineness is around 330 m²/kg Blaine, specific gravity about 2.9, bulk density about 1250 kg/m³ and standard consistency about 30%. Le Chatelier soundness expansion is about 1 mm and drying shrinkage about 0.07%. Chloride is held below 0.05% and SO₃ below 2.6%. Heat of hydration at 7 days is around 235 kJ/kg — the reduced hydration heat that blended cements are chosen for on thicker pours.

## Application and installation notes

Mix dry, then add water gradually; place and compact within about 30 minutes. Cure with water for 14 days — pozzolanic strength arrives later than with OPC. Work between 5 °C and 40 °C. Stack no more than 10 bags high on wooden planks in a dry covered store, clear of external walls, and use within 3 months of packing.

## What's in the box

sku.short: Ambuja Plus Cement, 50 kg bag. PPC with SPE technology for denser, leak-resistant slabs, foundations, masonry and plaster.
sku.long:
## What it is

Ambuja Plus is a Portland Pozzolana Cement made with SPE — Special Performance Enhancer — technology, supplied in a 50 kg HDPE/PP laminated woven bag. The dry-process blend inter-grinds clinker with fly ash and gypsum, and the SPE route works by extracting the silicate gel present in the cement so the hardened matrix packs denser and lets less water through. It is a blended cement to IS 1489 (Part 1) and so carries no numeric strength grade.

## What it's for

Ambuja aims this bag at the whole house: foundation concrete, beams and columns, brick masonry, wall plastering and slab casting. Its distinctive pitch is roofing in heavy-rainfall regions — the denser, leak-resistant concrete is what the product is sold on, which makes it a sensible default for terraces, sunken slabs and other water-facing elements in coastal Andhra Pradesh. For ordinary residential work it fits concrete around M15 to M30 at a water–cement ratio near 0.45.

## Key specifications

The blend runs approximately 65% clinker, 31% fly ash and 4% gypsum. Expect around 25 MPa compressive strength at 3 days, 36 MPa at 7 days and 50 MPa at 28 days, with initial set at about 140 minutes and final set at about 215 minutes. Fineness is around 345 m²/kg Blaine, specific gravity about 2.9, bulk density about 1250 kg/m³ and standard consistency about 30%. Le Chatelier soundness expansion is about 1 mm and drying shrinkage about 0.06%. Chloride stays below 0.05% and SO₃ below 2.6%, with heat of hydration at 7 days around 235 kJ/kg.

## Application and installation notes

Mix the dry constituents until uniform, then add water gradually. The mix stays cohesive and shows reduced rebound loss in masonry, so less mortar is wasted off the wall. Place and compact within about 30 minutes, then cure with water for a full 14 days — pozzolanic strength arrives later than with OPC, and the leak resistance depends on that curing. Work between 5 °C and 40 °C. Stack no more than 10 bags high on wooden planks in a dry covered store, clear of external walls, and use within 3 months of packing.

## What's in the box

sku.short: Wipro Garnet 9 W B22 LED bulb, 900 lm cool day white 6500 K, 240° spread, works from 100-300 V AC with 4 kV surge protection.
sku.long:
## What it is

The Wipro Garnet 9 W B22 Cool Day White LED bulb (catalogue number N96101) is the 9-watt bayonet-cap node of Wipro's mainstream Garnet household LED range. It is a round A-shape lamp in a polycarbonate body with a frosted diffuser and a B22 cap, and it puts out 900 lumens of 6500 K cool day white — about 100 lumens per watt.

## What it's for

Everyday indoor lighting: bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, passages, and small offices and shops running on existing B22 holders. Wipro sells it for home and office use, and the carton restricts it to indoor applications. At 900 lm it is a like-for-like replacement for an ordinary incandescent bulb in the same holder.

## Key specifications

Rated 220-240 V AC at 50 Hz, the lamp is built around a wide operating window: it keeps running from 100 V to 300 V AC, carries 400 V high-voltage protection and 4 kV of surge protection, which is the reason to reach for it on a feeder that swings. The LEDs are LM-80 tested so the brightness holds over the lamp's life, and the 240° beam gives a wide, glare-free spread rather than a narrow pool. The carton declares base cap B22, IS 16102 (Part 1) with the BIS standard mark, no UV or IR radiation, non-dimmable operation, and net quantity 1 N. The lamp is made in India by Wipro Enterprises (P) Ltd.

## Application and installation notes

Push the cap into the B22 holder and twist a quarter turn. It is not dimmable, so keep it off dimmer and regulator circuits. Do not fit it in a totally enclosed fixture — the carton says so explicitly, and a sealed fitting traps the heat the lamp needs to shed. Indoor use only; it has no declared IP rating and is not intended for open verandas or outdoor fittings. Being polycarbonate rather than glass it will survive a knock that would shatter a filament bulb.

## What's in the box

One lamp in a printed Garnet carton, net quantity 1 N, with the catalogue number, base cap, voltage, IS standard, BIS mark and MRP block printed on the declaration panel. Wipro's usual lamp warranty is one year from date of purchase.

## What it is

The Philips Ace Saver 9 W B22 Cool Day Light LED bulb (Philips 12NC 929001198414) is the value tier of Philips India's household lamp range and the model most Indian buyers mean when they ask for "a Philips bulb". It is a round polycarbonate lamp with a frosted envelope and a B22 bayonet cap, drawing 9 W and delivering 806 lumens at 6500 K cool day light. It is made and packed in India by Philips India Ltd at Nalagarh, Himachal Pradesh.

## What it's for

Everyday indoor lighting: living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and passages, and equally at home in an office or a shop on an existing B22 holder. It goes straight into the holder an ordinary incandescent bulb came out of, with no rewiring and no change of fitting.

## Key specifications

The lamp runs on 220-240 V AC mains and consumes 9 W for 806 lumens, which works out at roughly 90 lumens per watt. Colour is 6500 K cool day light with a colour rendering index around 80. Philips builds the range around its EyeComfort claim: glare is reduced and light flicker minimised so the light does not cause eye strain or fatigue over a long evening. The beam carries no infra-red, so the lamp radiates no heat forward, and no ultra-violet, so fabrics and pictures under it do not fade. The body and diffuser are polycarbonate. The lamp measures 60 mm across and 110 mm tall and is non-dimmable.

## Application and installation notes

Push the cap into a standard B22 bayonet holder and twist a quarter turn to lock. Keep it off dimmer and regulator circuits — it is not a dimmable lamp. Avoid fully enclosed fittings, which trap the heat the driver needs to shed. Indoor use only; no IP rating is declared, so it is not for open verandas or outdoor fittings. Because the envelope is polycarbonate and not glass, a knock that would shatter a filament bulb generally will not break it.

## What's in the box

One lamp in a printed Philips carton carrying the 12NC, the EAN barcode and the MRP block. Philips also packs the same lamp in 2, 3, 4, 6 and 10-lamp multipacks. The usual Philips lamp warranty is one year from date of purchase, claimed through the seller or Philips India consumer care.

## What it is

The Havells LED Plus 9 W B22 CDL Lamp V7 (model LHLDDDBNL5R009) is a self-ballasted LED bulb with a round polycarbonate body, an opal polycarbonate diffuser and a B22 bayonet cap — the ordinary pin-type holder used in almost every Indian house. It draws 9 W and puts out 849 lumens of 6500 K cool day light, which works out to 94.44 lm/W and earns it a BEE 1 Star label. Havells makes it in India and sells it under its Adore+ LED lamp identity.

## What it's for

General indoor lighting: living rooms and bedrooms first, and equally at home in a corporate office, a shop, a restaurant or a hotel corridor. At 849 lm it replaces a roughly 57 W incandescent bulb one-for-one in the same holder, so it is the straightforward swap when an old bulb fails or when a new flat is being lamped up.

## Key specifications

It runs on 220-240 V AC at 50 Hz and draws 0.05 A, with a power factor of at least 0.90 and total harmonic distortion below 33 %. The point that matters on an unstable feeder is the withstand range: the lamp keeps working from 140 V to 270 V, starts from 100 V, carries 4 kV of in-built surge protection and 3.75 kV of isolation. The colour rendering index is 80 or better, start-up is under two seconds, and there is no flicker visible at rated voltage and no UV or IR in the beam. Rated life is 15,000 hours to the F50 L70 code with 7,500 switching cycles. The lamp measures 60 mm across and 113 mm tall, weighs 48 g net, and is rated IP20 for ambient temperatures of 0-35 °C.

## Application and installation notes

Push the cap into the B22 holder and twist a quarter turn; any orientation is fine. It is not dimmable, so keep it off dimmer and regulator circuits. Do not fit it inside a fully enclosed luminaire — the IP20 rating and the 0-35 °C ambient limit both assume the lamp can shed its heat into open air. Being polycarbonate rather than glass, it survives a knock that would shatter a filament bulb.

## What's in the box

One lamp in a printed carton, net contents 1 N, carton 65 × 60 × 120 mm. Trade packing is a master box of 316 × 316 × 250 mm weighing 3.14 kg. The lamp carries a one-year Havells warranty.

sku.short: Fosroc Conbextra EP10 solvent-free epoxy resin free-flow grout, 1 litre pack. 80 MPa at 7 days, fills 0.25-10 mm gaps.
sku.long:
## What it is

Conbextra EP10 is Fosroc's high-strength epoxy resin grout: a solvent-free, all-liquid two-can system of base and hardener, supplied in the correct proportions for whole-pack mixing on site. It flows freely into gaps of 0.25 to 10 mm and cures to a non-shrink mass that keeps full surface-to-surface contact with both the foundation and the plate above it.

## What it's for

Underplate grouting to substantial structural elements, and base-plate grouting where dynamic loads are the problem — turbines, reciprocating machinery, crane and transporter rails. It is written into heavy industrial specifications for steelworks, refineries, chemical plants and electroplating works, where chemical spillage would attack a cementitious grout. The same pack doubles as a low-viscosity injection resin for filling cracks, honeycombs and cavities in high-strength concrete from 0.25 mm upward.

## Key specifications

Compressive strength reaches 45 MPa at one day, 60 MPa at three days and 80 MPa at seven days — the figure Fosroc writes into its own specification clause. Tensile strength is 20 MPa and flexural strength 40 MPa at seven days. Mixed density is about 1.05 kg/L and pot life is 50 minutes at 27 °C. It conforms to BS EN 1504-3 Class R4 and BS EN 1504-6 for anchoring of reinforcing steel bar; no BIS mark is declared. Shelf life is 12 months below 35 °C. The product is suitable for structural use and resists repetitive dynamic loading with low creep under sustained load.

## Application notes

The foundation must be free of oil, grease and loose material, with laitance cut back to a sound base and bolt pockets blown clean. Take steel base plates to a bright finish (SA 2½) and prime with Nitoprime 25 if placement will be delayed. Formwork must be leak-proof — this is a free-flow grout. Pour the whole hardener can into the base, mix two to three minutes to a uniform colour, then pour from one side through a feeding hopper, holding a continuous hydrostatic head so no air is trapped. For injection work, drill 8-10 mm holes, fix nipples with epoxy putty and inject until resin emerges from the next nipple. Above 35 °C, keep material and equipment cool and avoid midday sun. Do not place in unrestrained situations.

## What's in the box

One 1 litre pack: base container plus separate hardener can, pre-proportioned for whole-pack mixing.

sku.short: Dr. Fixit Epoxy Injection Grout (206), 3 kg pack. Two-part low-viscosity moisture-insensitive resin for structural crack injection.
sku.long:
## What it is

Dr. Fixit Epoxy Injection Grout, product 206 in Pidilite's building-repairs range, is a two-component, solvent-free, moisture-insensitive epoxy with a deliberately low viscosity. Base resin and hardener are supplied pre-proportioned at 100 : 60 by weight and mixed whole until the liquid runs clear. Once injected it penetrates deep into a crack and cures to a shrink-free solid mass that bonds the two faces back together.

## What it's for

Structural crack repair. It is used to seal and permanently bond cracks in concrete floors, walls, slabs, water tanks and sea walls, and to fill honeycombing and cavities in concrete and masonry. Because it is shrink free, waterproof and stronger than the parent concrete, it is specified on heavy structures — bridges, dams and buildings — as well as on ordinary building repairs.

## Key specifications

Compressive strength exceeds 40 MPa at one day and 70 MPa at seven days to BS 6319 Part 2; flexural strength exceeds 30 MPa and tensile strength 15 MPa at seven days. Specific gravity is 1.02 to 1.08 and fresh mix density 1.02 kg/L. Brookfield viscosity is 2 to 6 poise at 30 °C — about 400 mPa·s — which is what lets it travel into a hairline crack. Pot life is 80 to 150 minutes at 30 °C and 65 % RH against a specification minimum of 50, and initial set is under 24 hours. Water permeability is capped at 2 % to ASTM C 881, and bond strength to ASTM D 4541 fails in the concrete rather than the bond line. Shelf life is 24 months. No BIS mark is declared.

## Application notes

The surface must be strong, dry and free of dust, oil, grease and curing compounds; blast, water-jet, acid-etch (washed to neutral) or grind it, then blow the crack clean with oil-free air. Drill into the crack at 40 to 50 degrees to at least a third of the member depth, fit packers 150 to 500 mm apart, and seal the surface between them with a 30-40 mm wide, 2-3 mm thick band, cured at least 8 hours at 35 °C. Inject with closed-container equipment at a minimum of 2 bar until resin emerges from the next packer, then leave undisturbed 24 hours. Mix only what the pot life allows, mix the whole pack, and never thin it with solvent.

## What's in the box

One 3 kg pack: base resin and hardener, pre-proportioned 100 : 60 by weight. Also supplied in 1 kg.

sku.short: Sikadur-31 IN two-part thixotropic structural epoxy adhesive and repair mortar, 6 kg pre-batched unit. Mix 2:1, 40 min pot life.
sku.long:
## What it is

Sikadur-31 IN is Sika's India formulation of its best-known structural epoxy: a solvent-free, moisture-tolerant, thixotropic two-part adhesive and repair mortar based on epoxy resin with special fillers. It is supplied as a factory pre-batched unit — Part A resin and Part B hardener in different colours, so a streak-free grey mix is your own proof that the blend is right. Rated for use between +10 °C and +40 °C, it is built for Indian site temperatures rather than European ones.

## What it's for

Three jobs in one pack. As a structural adhesive it bonds concrete elements, hard natural stone, ceramics, fibre cement, mortar, brick, block and masonry, steel, iron, aluminium, wood, polyester, epoxy and glass. As a fast-setting repair mortar it rebuilds corners, edges, joint arises and fills holes and voids. As a filler it seals rigid joints and non-moving cracks. It is suitable for structural use, indoors and out.

## Key specifications

Mix Part A to Part B at 2:1 by weight and you get roughly 40 minutes of pot life at +30 °C. Mixed density is 1.80 kg/L and the paste is non-sag up to 10 mm on a vertical face, so it stays where you put it overhead. Cured strengths reach 55 MPa in compression and 20 MPa in flexure at seven days, with tensile strength of 8 MPa and a tensile adhesion strength to concrete of 10 MPa — a bond that fails in the concrete, not the glue line. Build up to 30 mm in a single layer. Conformity is declared to ASTM C 881 Type I, Grade 3, Class B+C; no BIS mark is claimed. Shelf life is 12 months.

## Application notes

Concrete must be at least 28 days old, sound, clean, and dry or matt damp — never under standing water. Prepare mechanically by blasting, scabbling or grinding to an open gripping profile and vacuum off all dust; take steel to bright metal. Mix Part A briefly, add Part B, and mix at most 300 rpm for three minutes plus a further minute after decanting. Apply to both faces with a spatula or trowel. Keep the substrate 3 °C above dew point and support heavy components until cure. Consumption is about 2.0 kg/m² per mm of thickness.

## What's in the box

One 6 kg pre-batched unit: Part A resin 4 kg and Part B hardener 2 kg. Also stocked in 3 kg and 30 kg units.

sku.long:
## What it is

The Ceasefire ABC Powder MAP 90 4 kg (product code CF-001144) is a stored-pressure portable fire extinguisher charged with 90% mono ammonium phosphate dry chemical powder. The shell is a two-piece welded deep-drawn steel cylinder, 140 mm across and 445 mm tall, finished in epoxy-polyester powder coating and fitted with a forged brass squeeze-grip valve, a pressure gauge and a discharge hose. Charged, the unit weighs about 6.5 kg.

## What it's for

One extinguisher covers Class A (wood, paper, textiles), Class B (flammable liquids), Class C (flammable gases) and electrically started fires, so the user does not have to identify the fire class before acting. That makes it the default first-aid appliance for homes, apartments, offices, shops and showrooms, godowns, workshops, electrical panel rooms and cars — roughly 55 m² of protected floor area per unit.

## Key specifications

It carries a 4A 144B rating under IS 15683 and 21A 144B under EN 3, works at 15 bar and is hydraulically tested at 35 bar. Rated service range is −30 °C to 60 °C, so it stays usable in an unventilated Telangana warehouse in May. Throw range is over 2 m and the charge empties in roughly 15 seconds of continuous discharge. Beyond the BIS certification to IS 15683, this range is dual-certified to EN 3 and PED and carries LPCB approval, the BSI Kitemark and CE marking. The manufacturer warranty runs 120 months.

## Application and installation notes

Follow IS 2190 for siting: mount on the supplied wall bracket with the carrying handle about 1 m above finished floor, on an escape route and clear of the hazard it protects. Keep the safety pin sealed until use. Inspect the gauge monthly — the needle must sit in the green band — and have the unit inspected every 12 months. Hydraulic re-testing is due every 3 years, and the extinguisher must be refilled after any discharge, however brief. Powder residue is non-conductive but fine, and needs vacuuming and wiping afterwards.

## What it is

The NewAge Extinguisher Box CA-EB-01 is a wall cabinet that houses one portable fire extinguisher. It measures 300 mm wide by 800 mm high by 300 mm deep and is built in mild steel; the same CA-EB range is also offered in stainless steel, FRP and polyethylene for corrosive and coastal locations, and in two-extinguisher sizes (CA-EB-02 and CA-EB-04, 600 mm wide).

**Listing note:** this is an enclosure, not an extinguisher. NewAge Fire Protection Industries manufactures fire-protection systems and hardware and does not make portable fire extinguishers, so no NewAge extinguisher exists to list under this brand.

## What it's for

An extinguisher mounted in the open on a factory wall, a jetty, a car park or an outdoor plant area gets sun, rain, dust and knocks, and the label and gauge stop being readable long before the cylinder fails. The cabinet gives the appliance environmental protection while keeping it visible and reachable, which is what IS 2190 requires of any housed first-aid fire appliance.

## Key specifications

Internal capacity is a single extinguisher. The steel is powder coated over a pre-treated surface for corrosion resistance, and the cabinet is normally supplied in signal red so it reads as fire equipment at a distance. NewAge itself is ISO 9001:2015 certified and holds BIS certification for couplings and branch pipes, landing valves and water-foam monitors; there is no published BIS or ISI licence for the extinguisher box, and none is claimed here.

## Application and installation notes

Fix the cabinet on an escape route with the housed extinguisher's carrying handle about 1 m above finished floor, per IS 2190. Keep the door unlocked or fitted with break-glass, never padlocked. Inspect at the same 12-month interval as the extinguisher it holds, and check the coating for rust bloom in coastal Andhra locations. The cabinet itself carries no extinguishing capability, so it must never be counted toward a building's extinguisher provision.

## What's in the box

## What it is

The Safex 6 kg ABC Portable Stored Pressure extinguisher is the mainstream ISI-marked unit from Safex Fire Services, in production since the company was founded in 1972. Charged weight is about 9.3 kg.

## What it's for

Safex lists it for homes and residential buildings, offices and commercial shops, industrial warehouses, and vehicles and transport hubs. Being an ABC unit it handles Class A, Class B, Class C and electrical fires from one cylinder, which is why it is the standard fit-out for factory floors and godowns where a single appliance has to cover mixed risk. At 6 kg it suits roughly 75 m² of protected area — a size up from the 4 kg unit typically used in homes.

## Key specifications

Rated 4A:55B, it works at 15 bar and is hydraulically tested at 35 bar. Discharge lasts about 25 seconds with a jet range of 6 m, which is a genuinely useful reach for warehouse aisles. It is ISI marked under BIS certification to IS 15683. Estimated envelope is roughly 160 mm across and 505 mm tall, so it fits a standard wall bracket or extinguisher cabinet.

## Application and installation notes

Site it per IS 2190: on the wall bracket, handle about 1 m above floor level, on an escape route and away from the hazard itself. Check the pressure gauge monthly and have the unit serviced every 12 months; hydraulic re-testing falls due every 3 years, and the cylinder must be refilled after any discharge. Safex designs the unit for easy refilling through its branch and distributor network, with the Secunderabad office covering Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Powder residue is non-conductive but fine and needs vacuuming afterwards.

sku.long:
## What it is

The Adani Solar ASB-M10-144-575 is a 575 Wp glass-to-glass bifacial module from the ELAN Shine TOPCon Gen-II range, built from 144 half-cut M10 n-type bifacial cells with multi-busbar interconnection. Both faces are glass — 2.0 mm anti-reflective coated high-transmission glass in front, 2.0 mm semi-tempered glass behind — laminated with a high volume-resistivity, low-MVTR encapsulant. At 22.3% module efficiency it is the most efficient of the three flagship panels in this catalogue.

## What it's for

Utility-scale ground-mounted plants and large commercial and industrial rooftops, where the higher efficiency means fewer modules, less structure and less cable for the same plant size. N-type cells hold their output better in the heat of the Deccan summer and carry no light-induced degradation loss, so the first-year drop is smaller than on a P-type module.

## Key specifications

At STC the module gives 575 Wp at 43.78 V and 13.14 A, with 52.3 V open-circuit and 13.89 A short-circuit. Power tolerance is 0 to +4.99 Wp. Temperature coefficients are −0.32 %/°C on power and −0.24 %/°C on Voc, with NOCT at 45 °C and an operating range of −40 °C to +85 °C. Maximum system voltage is 1500 V and the maximum series fuse rating is 30 A. The laminate is rated for 3600 Pa downward and 1600 Pa upward load at a design safety factor of 1.5. The panel measures 2278 mm × 1133 mm × 30 mm and weighs 33.5 kg. The IP68 junction box feeds 300 mm leads terminated in MC4-compatible connectors. Approvals listed on the datasheet cover IEC 61215, IEC 61730, IEC 61701 salt mist, IEC 62716 ammonia and IEC 60068-2-68 sand and dust, alongside BIS registration.

## Application and installation notes

Bolt it through the frame mounting holes or clamp it to the rail, keeping within the 3600 Pa / 1600 Pa load ratings. Note the higher 52.3 V open-circuit voltage — check string length against the 1500 V system limit and against your inverter's cold-morning window. Leave clearance and a light-coloured surface behind the array to collect the rear-side gain. At 33.5 kg it is a two-person lift.

## What's in the box

One 575 Wp module with junction box, 300 mm leads and MC4-compatible connectors fitted. Structure, clamps, earthing hardware and DC cable are supplied separately. Warranty: 12 years on product, 30 years on performance, with degradation under 1.0% in the first year and under 0.40% a year thereafter, reaching 87.4% of rated power at year 30.

The Vikram Solar Paradea VSMDH.72.550.05 is a 550 Wp bifacial glass-glass module built from 72 Mono PERC P-type bifacial cells cut into 144 half-cells on the M10 format and joined with multi-busbar ribbons. Both faces are glass — 2.0 mm anti-reflective coated semi-tempered low-iron glass in front, 2.0 mm heat-strengthened low-iron glass behind — laminated with an EVA/EPE encapsulant inside an anodised aluminium frame of twin-wall section. Module efficiency at standard test conditions is 21.29%.

## What it's for

Commercial and industrial rooftops, institutional campuses and ground-mounted plants, including single-axis trackers — the frame carries dedicated tracker holes as well as installing and grounding holes. A DCR-content version of this model is offered, which matters for subsidy-linked rooftop work in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

## Key specifications

At STC the module delivers 550 Wp at 41.9 V and 13.14 A, with 49.7 V open-circuit and 13.82 A short-circuit, at a power tolerance of 0 to +3%. Temperature coefficients are −0.35 %/°C on power and −0.27 %/°C on Voc, NOCT is 45 °C ± 2 °C and the operating range is −40 °C to +85 °C. Maximum system voltage is 1500 V with a 25 A maximum series fuse. The laminate is rated for 5400 Pa of snow load and 2400 Pa of wind load and has passed a 45 mm hail test at impact velocities up to 27 m/s at a third-party laboratory. It measures 2278 mm × 1134 mm × 30 mm and weighs 32.5 kg. The IP68 split junction box carries individual bypass diodes and MC4-compatible leads. Certification covers IS 14286:2010 / IEC 61215:2005 and IS/IEC 61730 Parts 1 and 2, plus IEC 61701 salt mist, IEC 62716 ammonia and IEC 60068-2-68 sand and dust.

## Application and installation notes

Fix it through the eight 9 × 14 mm installing holes; four Ø4 mm grounding holes and four 7 × 10 mm tracker holes are provided in the frame. Earth every module at a grounding hole. Being bifacial, it wants clearance and a reflective surface behind the array. Check string length against the 1500 V limit and the 49.7 V open-circuit voltage. At 32.5 kg it is a two-person lift.

## What's in the box

One 550 Wp module with split junction box, cables and MC4-compatible connectors fitted. Structure, clamps, earthing hardware and DC cable are supplied separately; modules ship 36 to a pallet. Warranty: 12 years on product, 30 years linear on power, with 2% first-year degradation and 0.5% a year thereafter, reaching 83.5% of rated power at year 30.

## What it is

The Waaree Bi-55-545 is a 545 Wp framed dual-glass bifacial solar module from Waaree's AHNAY Series, built from 144 half-cut M10 Mono PERC bifacial cells (91 × 182 mm) laid out 12×6 || 12×6 and interconnected with multi-busbar ribbons. Instead of a polymer backsheet it uses a second sheet of 2 mm low-iron printed semi-tempered glass, so the rear face also collects light. Module efficiency at standard test conditions is 21.17%.

## What it's for

Grid-tied rooftop solar on houses, apartment blocks and commercial buildings, and ground-mounted captive plants where the reflected light off a light-coloured roof or hardstanding can be turned into extra output. The glass-glass sandwich is the more durable of the two common constructions, which is why it carries a 30-year power-output warranty rather than the usual 25.

## Key specifications

At STC the module delivers 545 Wp at 41.9 V and 13.02 A, with an open-circuit voltage of 49.76 V and a short-circuit current of 13.9 A. Maximum system voltage is 1500 V and the maximum series fuse rating is 25 A. Temperature coefficients are −0.34 %/°C on power and −0.25 %/°C on Voc, with NOCT at 43 °C and an operating range of −40 °C to +85 °C. The laminate is rated for 5400 Pa of front load and 2400 Pa of rear load. The panel measures 2272 mm tall × 1133 mm wide × 35 mm deep and weighs 32.5 kg. The IP68 weatherproof PPO junction box carries three bypass diodes and 500 mm of 4 mm² cable ending in IP68 MC4-compatible connectors.

## Application and installation notes

It bolts to the mounting structure through eight 14 × 9 mm holes in the frame; clamp mounting is permitted per Waaree's installation manual. Because it is bifacial, leave clearance behind the array and avoid dark or shaded backgrounds if you want the rear-side gain. At 32.5 kg and 2.27 m long it is a two-person lift. Check string length against the 1500 V system limit and the 49.76 V open-circuit voltage before wiring.

## What's in the box

One 545 Wp module with pre-attached junction box, cables and MC4-compatible connectors. Mounting structure, clamps, earthing hardware and cable are not included. Warranty: 12 years on product and workmanship, 30 years on power output, with 82.05% of rated power guaranteed at year 30.

sku.long:
## What it is

Floral Crema (article YK1FLCR000000PJ) is a polished vitrified tile from Elite DSF RT24, the 600 x 1200 mm collection of Marbonite by Johnson. Johnson describes the Marbonite StainFree series as fully vitrified and easy on maintenance; the tile is a dry-pressed porcelain body in a cream marble design, 9 mm thick.

## What it's for

Johnson lists the application as floor and wall, which is how the 2 x 4 ft format is used across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana - a continuous polished floor through living, dining and bedroom areas, with the same tile carried up a feature wall. PEI IV abrasion and a vitrified body cover domestic traffic and light-commercial interiors such as offices and showrooms. With an R9 slip class and a polished face this is an indoor, dry-area tile - not for balconies, terraces or open parking.

## Key specifications

The body is Group BIa vitrified porcelain with water absorption at or below 0.5%, the property behind both the stain tolerance and the dimensional stability a 1200 mm tile needs. Breaking strength is taken at 1300 N with a modulus of rupture of 35 N/mm², to IS 15622 and the ISO 10545 test series, surface hardness around MOHS 6 and stain resistance Class 5. Dimensional tolerance is held to 0.6%, so the rectified edge closes on a 2 mm joint. The StainFree surface is the range's own low-maintenance polished face.

## Application and installation notes

Fix thin-bed over a levelled, fully cured screed using a polymer-modified adhesive to IS 15477 - Ardex Endura, the group's own adhesive brand, is the matched product. Back-butter each tile so nothing is hollow across the 1200 mm span, hold joints at 2 mm, and check the box batch before laying, since shade variation is V2.

## What's in the box

One box holds 2 tiles covering 1.44 m² (about 15.5 sqft) and weighs about 31 kg. Sold by the box under HSN 6907 at 18% GST.

sku.long:
## What it is

Venato Bianco (model GP00215) is a glazed vitrified tile from Kajaria's 600 x 1200 mm range. It is a dry-pressed porcelain body carrying a digitally printed white marble design under a nano-polished glaze, sold in a rectified 600 x 1200 mm module, 9 mm thick.

## What it's for

Kajaria lists it for both floor and wall use, which is how the 2 x 4 ft format is normally specified in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana: a continuous polished floor through living, dining and bedroom areas, with the same tile carried up a feature wall so the veining runs uninterrupted. Its PEI IV abrasion class and vitrified body suit domestic traffic and light-commercial interiors such as showrooms and offices. With an R9 slip class and a polished surface it is an indoor, dry-area tile - not a balcony, terrace or open-parking tile.

## Key specifications

The body is a Group BIa vitrified porcelain with water absorption at or below 0.5%, which is what keeps a polished large-format tile dimensionally stable and stain-tolerant. Breaking strength is taken at 1300 N with a modulus of rupture of 35 N/mm², both to IS 15622 and the ISO 10545 test series, and surface hardness is around MOHS 6. Dimensional tolerance is held to 0.6%, so the rectified edges close up on a 2 mm joint. Stain resistance is Class 5 and the tile is frost resistant and resistant to thermal shock.

## Application and installation notes

Fix thin-bed over a levelled, fully cured screed using polymer-modified adhesive - Kajaria recommends Gresbond VX-1 or VX-2 internally and EX-5 externally. Back-butter each tile so there are no voids under a 1200 mm span, keep joints at 2 mm, and check the shade batch on the box before laying, since shade variation is V2.

## What's in the box

One box holds 2 tiles, covering 1.44 m² (about 15.5 sqft), and weighs about 31 kg. Sold by the box under HSN 6907 at 18% GST.

sku.long:
## What it is

The CP PLUS CP-USC-TA24L2C-L is a 2.4 MP HD analogue bullet camera from the Illumax dual-light range, built on the familiar Cosmic bullet body. It is a white plastic bullet with a black front bezel, 163.4 mm long, 70 mm wide and 69.7 mm tall, weighing 0.18 kg, with a 3.6 mm fixed lens giving an 83° horizontal field of view. Beside the lens sit two infrared and two warm-white LEDs, and a microphone is built in. The housing is rated IP67, and the camera is made in India.

## What it's for

It is the camera for house gates, compound walls, shop fronts, parking areas and school or godown perimeters where the owner wants colour video after dark and sound with it, recorded on an HD analogue DVR. The single BNC output switches between CVI, TVI, AHD and CVBS, so it works with CP PLUS DVRs and with most other 4-in-1 recorders, and it can take the place of an older analogue camera on the same coaxial cable.

## Key specifications

The 2.4 MP PS CMOS sensor delivers 1920 × 1080 video at up to 30 fps, with 960H available on CVBS. Minimum illumination is 0.01 lux. At night the camera can run in IR mode (black and white to about 20 m), warm-light mode (colour to about 20 m) or a smart mode that switches between the two. The bracket pans 360°, tilts 90° and rotates 360°. Power is 12 V DC at a maximum of 2.6 W. It is rated for −40 °C to 60 °C at up to 95% humidity, which covers a west-facing wall in Vijayawada in May. The Indian safety reference for cameras of this class is IS 13252 (Part 1) / IEC 62368-1. Warranty is 24 months carry-in under the Aditya Infotech service policy; the power adapter is excluded.

## Installation notes

Mount on a wall or ceiling at about 3 m using the integral bracket, seal the cable joint against rain, and aim using the three adjustment axes. Run coaxial cable to the DVR and select the CVI, TVI or AHD mode to match the recorder; audio travels on the same cable. Use a regulated 12 V DC supply sized for 2.6 W per camera. Choose the warm-light mode where colour identification matters and the IR mode where a visible light would disturb neighbours. Keep the serial sticker intact and the invoice safe for warranty claims.

## What's in the box

One camera with integral bracket, video and power pigtail, mounting screws and wall plugs, a drilling template and a quick guide, in a single printed carton.

## What it is

The Dahua HAC-HDW1200TRQ (ordering code DH-HAC-HDW1200TRQP for PAL) is the S6 version of Dahua's 2 MP Lite Series HDCVI eyeball camera. It is a white plastic turret, 97.1 mm across and 93 mm tall, weighing 0.14 kg, with a 3.6 mm fixed M12 lens that gives an 83° horizontal field of view. The body sits on a quick-to-install pedestal that screws straight to the surface. This base TRQP model has no microphone. It is rated IP50 — protected against dust but not against water — so it belongs indoors or under cover.

## What it's for

It is the workhorse camera for homes, shops, small offices, apartment corridors and godowns running on Dahua HDCVI or any 4-in-1 DVR. The single BNC output switches between CVI, TVI, AHD and CVBS, so it can replace an old analogue camera on the existing coaxial cable without changing the recorder.

## Key specifications

The 2 MP progressive-scan CMOS sensor produces 1920 × 1080 video at up to 30 fps, with 960H output available on CVBS. Minimum illumination is 0.01 lux, and two smart-IR LEDs light the scene in black and white to about 30 m — further than most 2 MP cameras in this class. The bracket pans 360°, tilts 78° and rotates 360°. Power is 12 V DC at a maximum of 2.7 W. It is rated for −40 °C to 60 °C at up to 95% humidity. The datasheet lists IEC/EN 62368-1 safety and EN 55032/55035 and FCC Part 15B EMC compliance. Warranty is 24 months.

## Installation notes

Fix the pedestal to a ceiling or wall at around 2.7 m, clip the eyeball on, and aim using the three adjustment axes. Keep it away from rain, splash and wash-down areas — IP50 is a dust rating only, and the camera is not rated for outdoor use. Run coaxial cable to the DVR and set the DVR channel to the CVI mode (or TVI/AHD for other recorders). Use a regulated 12 V DC supply sized for 2.7 W per camera. If sound recording is needed, specify the HAC-HDW1200TRQ-A variant instead.

## What it is

The Hikvision DS-2CE76D0T-ITPFS is a 2 MP Turbo HD turret camera from the Value Series, fitted with a built-in microphone that sends audio down the same coaxial cable as the video. The camera runs from 12 V DC and draws a maximum of 2.7 W, and it is rated for −40 °C to 60 °C at up to 90% humidity, so a sealed Telangana shop in May is well inside its envelope. The Indian safety reference for cameras of this class is IS 13252 (Part 1) / IEC 62368-1, and the warranty is 24 months.

## Installation notes

Mount on the ceiling or a wall at around 2.7 m, aim with the three adjustment axes, and keep it out of rain and direct water — it is not weather-sealed and is not rated for outdoor use. Run a single coaxial cable back to the DVR; the microphone audio travels on the same cable, so no separate audio line is needed. Power it from a regulated 12 V DC supply and enable audio on the matching DVR channel so that sound is recorded with the video.

## What's in the box

One camera with its video and power pigtail, mounting screws and wall plugs, a drilling template and a quick start guide, packed in a single printed carton.

sku.long:
## What it is

AIS Ecosense Edge Natura Plus is a 6 mm coated glass from Asahi India Glass's Ecosense range, in the Edge sub-range that AIS developed for single-glazing use. A multilayer metal-oxide coating on clear soda-lime float glass gives the pane both solar control and a measure of thermal insulation, which is why it is grouped here as a low-emissivity glass; the neutral shade keeps the view colour-true. It is supplied as one annealed monolithic pane, so it is not a safety glass as delivered, and a processor can toughen or laminate it to IS 2553 Part 1 if required. At about 15 kg per square metre, a 1200 × 1800 mm pane weighs roughly 32 kg.

## What it's for

Windows and residential glazing: large living-room sliders, bedroom windows and balcony glazing in houses and apartments across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, and small façades and structural glazing on low-rise commercial buildings. It is rated for exterior use with the coated face to the interior; as supplied it is not meant for overhead glazing.

## Key specifications

For the 6 mm single pane AIS publishes a visible light transmission of 45%, external reflection of 20%, a solar factor of 42% (SHGC 0.42) and a U-value of 4.6 W/m²K, computed to ISO 9050 for light and solar values and EN 673 for the U-value. Emissivity is estimated at about 0.4, UV transmission around 20% and sound reduction about 31 dB. Thermal-shock resistance is 40 °C and bending strength 41 MPa, the usual values for annealed float. The substrate is IS 14900 float glass; IS 2553 Part 1 applies only once toughened or laminated, and IS 16231 only if the pane is built into the 6-12-6 DGU configuration AIS also lists.

## Installation notes

Glaze with the coating on surface 2 — the inside face of the outer pane — in uPVC or aluminium frames or structural-glazing systems, with at least 12 mm edge engagement, setting blocks and neutral-cure silicone. The coated annealed pane can be cut to size at the dealer; handle the coated face with clean gloves, keep it dry in storage and do not use abrasive pads on it. Order toughened panes for doors, railings and oversized lights.

## What's supplied

Cut-to-size panes with as-cut edges and the coated face marked, interleaved with paper or cork pads and delivered on an A-frame or in a wooden crate. Minimum order 10 sqft; typical lead time about 7 days through AIS processors in Hyderabad and Vijayawada. Warranty is recorded as 120 months on the coating, to be confirmed with the AIS dealer. HSN 7005, GST 18%.

## What it is

Guardian ClimaGuard Blue is a 5 mm durable coated solar-control glass from Guardian's ClimaGuard residential range, made on a clear float substrate and supplied as a single annealed monolithic pane. Guardian lists the coating as usable monolithic or in an insulating glass unit, with heat-strengthened, heat-soaked, laminated and bent processing options and no edge deletion required. As delivered it is not a safety glass; a processor can toughen or laminate it to IS 2553 Part 1. It weighs about 12.5 kg per square metre, so a 1200 × 1800 mm pane is roughly 27 kg.

## What it's for

Windows and residential glazing — Guardian names windows, skylights, roof windows and doors for this product — in houses, apartments and small commercial buildings across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. It is suitable for exterior use with the coating on surface 2, and it is rated for overhead glazing, where it should be laminated or toughened to satisfy IS 2553 Part 1.

## Key specifications

Guardian publishes the thickness range (3.5, 4 and 5 mm), a maximum pane size under 3660 × 2550 mm and the blue appearance, but not optical or thermal numbers for India, so the following are indicative values for a 5 mm durable-coated blue solar-control glass: visible light transmission about 36%, external reflection about 18%, solar heat gain coefficient about 0.45, U-value about 5.7 W/m²K, emissivity about 0.84, UV transmission about 20% and sound reduction about 30 dB. Thermal-shock resistance is 40 °C and bending strength 41 MPa, as for annealed float. The substrate is IS 14900 float glass; IS 16231 applies only if the pane is made into a DGU.

## Installation notes

Glaze with the coated face towards the interior (surface 2), with at least 12 mm edge engagement, setting blocks and neutral-cure silicone or EPDM gaskets in uPVC or aluminium frames. The annealed coated pane is cuttable and needs no edge deletion. Handle the coated side with clean gloves, avoid abrasive cleaning on it, and wash with water and a mild detergent. Order toughened or laminated panes for doors, skylights and large openings.

## What's supplied

Cut-to-size panes with as-cut edges and the coated face marked, interleaved with paper or cork pads and delivered on an A-frame or in a wooden crate from dealer stock. Minimum order 10 sqft; 4 and 5 mm are on Guardian's short lead time, typically about 7 days through Hyderabad dealers. Warranty is recorded as 120 months on the coating, to be confirmed with the dealer. HSN 7005, GST 18%.

## What it is

Saint-Gobain Sun Ban SGG Sapphire Blue is a 5 mm solar-control glass from Saint-Gobain's Sun Ban range for residences. A pyrolytic coating is fired onto clear soda-lime float glass on the float line itself, so the coating is a hard coat, and the pane reads as a reflective blue from outside. It is supplied as a single monolithic pane, annealed, so it is not a safety glass as delivered; a processor can toughen or laminate it to IS 2553 Part 1 if a door, railing or large opening calls for it. ## What it's for

Windows and residential glazing: sliding and casement windows, balconies, staircase glazing and small façades on houses and apartments in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, where the need is to cut afternoon heat without losing the view. It is suitable for exterior use. As supplied — annealed and monolithic — it is not intended for overhead glazing.

## Key specifications

At 5 mm, visible light transmission is 22.9% with 23.7% external reflection, which gives strong glare control and daytime privacy. The solar heat gain coefficient is 0.39, so a little under 40% of incident solar energy reaches the room, and the U-value is 5.72 W/m²K. UV transmission is in the region of 15% and sound reduction about 30 dB for the single pane. Thermal-shock resistance is the usual 40 °C of annealed glass and bending strength 41 MPa. The substrate is IS 14900 transparent float glass; IS 2553 Part 1 applies only once the pane is toughened or laminated, and IS 16231 only if it is built into a DGU.

## Installation notes

Install with the coated face towards the interior (surface 2) — Saint-Gobain states this protects the coating from weathering and keeps reflectivity consistent. Keep at least 12 mm of edge engagement in the frame, use setting blocks and a neutral-cure silicone or EPDM gasket in uPVC, aluminium or timber frames. The hard coat is cuttable, so panes can be cut and arrised at the dealer or on site, but edges should be clean-cut to limit thermal-stress breakage on sunny elevations. Clean with water and a mild detergent only; no abrasive pads on the coated face.

## What's supplied

Cut-to-size panes with as-cut edges, interleaved with paper or cork pads and delivered on an A-frame or in a wooden crate. Minimum order 10 sqft; typical lead time about 5 days from Hyderabad and Vijayawada stockists. Warranty is recorded as 120 months on the coating, to be confirmed on the dealer invoice. sku.short: Leica FlexLine TS07 2" R500 manual total station: 500 m reflectorless, 3,500 m to prism, 30x telescope, FlexField touchscreen, IP66, 30 h battery.
sku.long:
## What it is

The Leica FlexLine TS07 is a manual total station from Leica Geosystems' FlexLine range, supplied here in the 2-second angular accuracy, R500 reflectorless configuration. Angles are read with 0.1" display resolution and held by a quadruple-axis compensator with a +/- 4' working range and 0.5" setting accuracy; distances come from a coaxial visible red-laser PinPoint EDM rated Class 3R under IEC 60825-1:2014. The instrument runs Leica FlexField software on a 3.5-inch 320 x 240 colour touchscreen with a 28-key illuminated keypad and a user-definable trigger key, and weighs about 4.3 kg.

## What it's for

It is built for building construction, civil engineering and survey-and-mapping work: control traverses, topographic pick-up, plot demarcation and, above all, setting out on site. Endless horizontal and vertical drives with drives on both sides make repetitive stakeout quicker, and the optional AutoHeight module measures the instrument height automatically so that one common setup error disappears.

## Key specifications

To a single prism the EDM is accurate to 1 mm + 1.5 ppm, with a 3,500 m range to a GPR1 round prism and a long-range mode beyond 10,000 m. Without a prism it reaches 500 m on a 90% reflective surface, at 2 mm + 2 ppm up to 500 m and 4 mm + 2 ppm beyond. The 30x telescope has a 1°30' field of view (2.7 m at 100 m), 3" resolving power and focuses from 1.5 m. Data lives on 2 GB of internal flash, an SD card or a USB stick and leaves through RS232, USB or Bluetooth, with WLAN and an LTE side cover as options. The GEB361 Li-ion battery gives up to 30 hours of measuring. The housing is sealed to IP66, rated from -20 °C to +50 °C and rain-tested to MIL-STD-810G.

## Field notes

The Class 2 laser plummet holds 1.5 mm at 1.5 m instrument height; level on the 6'/2 mm circular bubble and refine on the 2" electronic level. Run the FlexField check-and-adjust routine after transport or a large temperature change, keep the 5/8-inch tripod screw tight, and respect the IP66 limit - the instrument shrugs off monsoon rain and dust but not immersion. The Indian dealer warranty is 12 months and extended warranty packages are available.

## What's in the case

TS07 instrument, GEB361 Li-ion battery with charger, tribrach, USB cable, adjustment tools, rain cover, user manual and the hard transport container. A calibration certificate is normally supplied with a new instrument.

sku.long:
## What it is

The Topcon GM-52 is the 2-second model of the GM-50 Series, a manual reflectorless total station with a magnesium-alloy housing, dual-face 192 x 80 dot graphic LCDs with 28-key illuminated keyboards, and Topcon's TopBasic onboard program. It weighs 5.1 kg with handle and battery and measures 183 x 181 x 348 mm.

## What it's for

Topcon positions the GM-50 Series as an entry-level site layout and survey tool: building construction, civil works, topographic and cadastral surveys. Stakeout routines are onboard, and Bluetooth lets the instrument work cable-free with MAGNET Field on a data collector, so a two-person crew can run layout without a cable to the controller.

## Key specifications

Angular accuracy is 2" (ISO 17123-3:2001) from a rotary absolute encoder read on two sides, held by a liquid dual-axis tilt sensor with +/- 6' range; IACS factory calibration keeps the angle system honest. The coaxial phase-shift EDM (690 nm red laser, Class 3R, Class 1-equivalent in prism mode) measures to 4,000 m on a standard prism at 1.5 mm + 2 ppm, and reflectorless to 500 m - 2 mm + 2 ppm to 200 m, 5 mm + 10 ppm to 350 m and 10 mm + 10 ppm to 500 m - with a 13 mm beam spot at 30 m. The 30x telescope with 45 mm objective has a 1°30' field of view, 2.5" resolving power and 1.3 m minimum focus. Internal memory holds about 50,000 points, and USB flash drives up to 32 GB plug into the Type-A port; RS-232C and Bluetooth Class 1.5 are also provided. The side-mounted BDC46C Li-ion battery (7.2 V, 2,430 mAh) runs about 14 hours in EDM eco mode (about 10 hours in normal fine mode) and charges in about 2.5 hours on the CDC68A charger. Protection is IP66; the operating range is -20 °C to +60 °C, with the instrument shaded above 50 °C.

## Field notes

The Class 2 laser plummet holds 1 mm at 1.3 m tripod height; level on the 10'/2 mm circular level and finish on the electronic circular level. After transport, check the levels, plummet, collimation, vertical index, tilt-sensor zero and EDM additive constant as the manual describes. The tripod thread is the standard 5/8-inch. The Indian dealer warranty is 12 months, and AMC or extended cover is available.

## What's in the case

GM-52 with tribrach, BDC46C battery and CDC68A charger, lens cap, tool kit, rain cover, instruction manual and the hard carrying case. A calibration certificate is normally supplied with a new instrument.

sku.long:
## What it is

The Trimble C5 is a mechanical (manual) total station built for Trimble by Nikon-Trimble in Japan, supplied here in the 2-second angular accuracy class. It pairs Nikon multi-coated optics with autofocus, a time-of-flight infrared EDM that is Class 1 laser-safe in both prism and reflectorless modes, and two 640 x 480 colour touchscreens - one on each face - running Trimble Access onboard on Windows Embedded Compact 7. The main unit weighs 4.3 kg and measures 206 x 169 x 318 mm.

## What it's for

Construction layout, road and rail earthworks, building surveys and boundary or topographic work where a crew wants a rugged, simple instrument whose job files flow straight into Trimble Business Center. Trimble Access gives stakeout and the usual survey routines from either face, so the operator never has to walk round the instrument.

## Key specifications

Angular accuracy is 2" (ISO 17123-3) from absolute encoders on 62 mm circles, with a dual-axis compensator of +/- 3' range. To a prism the EDM measures +/- (2 mm + 2 ppm) out to 5,000 m; without a prism it reaches 800 m at +/- (3 mm + 2 ppm) in standard mode or +/- (10 mm + 5 ppm) in fast standard mode. The 30x telescope has a 45 mm objective, a 1°25' field of view, 3" resolving power and focuses from 1.5 m, with Nikon autofocus and four-step reticle illumination. Memory is 512 MB RAM plus 4 GB flash; connections are one RS-232C serial port, two USB ports, integrated Bluetooth and WLAN. Two hot-swappable 3.6 V Li-ion packs give about 12 hours of distance-and-angle work (14 hours angle-only, 7 hours continuous) and recharge in about 6 hours. The body is sealed to IP66 and rated from -20 °C to +50 °C.

## Field notes

Choose the optical-plummet model (3x, 0.5 m minimum focus) or the Class 2 laser-plummet model. Level on the tribrach's 10'/2 mm circular vial, then on the electronic level. The user guide's checking-and-adjustment chapter covers the electronic and circular levels, the plummet, vertical zero-point and horizontal-angle corrections, the instrument constant and autofocus calibration - run it after transport. Both axes have clamps with tangent screws; the tripod thread is the standard 5/8-inch. The dealer warranty is typically 12 months, with extended plans available.

## What's in the case

Instrument main body with tribrach, two battery packs, battery charger and AC adapter, adjustment pin and Allen wrench, rain/dust cover, shoulder strap and USB cable, all in the 3.3 kg hard carrying case. A calibration certificate is normally supplied with a new instrument.

product.name: Trimble C5 2" Mechanical Total Station

primary_use.value: Construction layout and survey integrated with Trimble Access and Trimble Business Center workflows

special_use.value: Mixed crews using Trimble GNSS rovers and machine control on the same job files

secondary_use.value: Topographic pick-up, earthworks volumes and as-built verification

parent_company.value: None - independent, Nasdaq-listed Trimble Inc. (TRMB, S&P 500), Westminster, Colorado; C-series total stations are built by the Nikon-Trimble Co., Ltd. joint venture in Japan

market_coverage.value: Global (about 11,500 employees, USD 3.59 bn revenue in 2025); in India through Trimble India and authorised distribution partners with offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai and Delhi-NCR

value.strong: Infrastructure and mining belts; Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR
value.balanced: Andhra Pradesh coastal districts and Telangana

novice_preference.value: Moderate - the touchscreen Access interface is easy to learn, but price and ecosystem suit established firms more than first-time buyers

product_portfolio.value: Field systems for surveying and positioning (C-series mechanical and S/SX robotic total stations, R-series GNSS, scanners), Trimble Access and Trimble Business Center software, AEC design tools, construction machine control, transportation and logistics platforms

bulk_discount_note.value: Fleet orders of three or more units typically earn 5-8% off and bundled Trimble Access training; software subscriptions are negotiated separately

dealer_margin_note.value: Distribution-partner margins on mechanical total stations are about 8-12%, with higher margins on software, service plans and accessories

engineer_user_rating.value: 4.4/5 - valued for the Trimble Access / Business Center workflow and the Nikon optics; seen as pricier than Topcon for equivalent manual specifications

contractor_preference.value: Strong among contractors already running Trimble GNSS or machine control who want one software ecosystem; moderate elsewhere

quality_strength_note.value: Nikon optics with autofocus, two colour touchscreens, IP66 body and a long-range time-of-flight EDM (5,000 m prism / 800 m reflectorless) that measures in about 2 seconds

project_vs_retail_cost_note.value: Project supply is normally quoted as a kit (instrument, tripod, prism set, Access licence) 10-20% above the bare instrument; retail single-unit buyers pay close to the listed dealer price
